name: Halvard Drawing Tablet Prime
description: The Halvard Drawing Tablet Prime. A dependable tablets pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Drawing Tablet, Folio sleeve, Stylus, USB-C cable, 20W adapter

reviews.author: Imran V.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Second Halvard product I own and both have lasted. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Tanvi N.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. No regrets.

reviews.author: Priya P.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Ordered twice, same problem both times. Support were polite but slow to respond. First Halvard product that has let me down. Cannot recommend it as-is.

reviews.author: Meera K.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Matches the listing description exactly. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Gaurav B.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Second Halvard product I own and both have lasted. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Meera C.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Second Halvard product I own and both have lasted. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Imran T.
reviews.title: Does the job
reviews.body: Mixed feelings after a few weeks of use. The finish scuffs more easily than I would like. Halvard have made better, but this is serviceable. Still, I am keeping it.
